goal: How many days are EU application logs retained? Cite the governing source.

policy-eu-2025.text: EU region: logs are retained for 60 days.
policy-eu-2025.title: EU logging policy (2025-06-01, superseded)

policy-eu-2026.text: This version supersedes the 2025 policy. EU region: application logs are retained for 30 days. Audit logs are not covered by this policy.
policy-eu-2026.title: EU logging policy (2026-04-15)

policy-us.text: US region: application logs are retained for 90 days.
policy-us.title: US logging policy (2026-03-01)
